PLAN "Postpartum Return — 12 Week Strength, Cardio & HIIT Program (Summary)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary_strength:
    name "Postpartum recovery and gradual return to strength"
  GOAL cardiovascular:
    name "Restore cardiovascular fitness with progressive conditioning"
  GOAL hiit_integration:
    name "Introduce low-impact HIIT after established tolerance to strength and steady cardio"
  GOAL progressive_strength:
    name "Gradual increase in strength training load after 6-week clearance, peak at week 12"
  GOAL core_recovery:
    name "Safe reintroduction of abdominal training after medical clearance"
  GOAL nutrition_support:
    name "Support breastfeeding with balanced higher-calorie, nutrient-dense intake"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 — Weeks 1-2 (Immediate post-op; walking & gentle activation; no direct abdominal loading)" (2 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Gentle mobilise & walk":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 2x10..15 rpe 2 rest 60 seconds
          cat_cow 3x6..8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 3x8..10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          bird_dog 3x6..8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Breath, mobility & walk":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 4x6..8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          cat_cow 3x6..8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          hip_circles 3x8..10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x6..8 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Walk & gentle strength":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 2x12..20 rpe 2 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x8..10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x6..8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          dead_bug 3x6..8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Progress walking & mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 2x12..20 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          cat_cow 3x8..10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 3x8..10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x8..12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Core-friendly activation":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 4x6..8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8..10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          bird_dog 3x8..10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          heel_slides 3x8..10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          standing_forward_fold 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Walk & glute focus":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 2x15..20 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x8..12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          hip_abduction 3x8..10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          clamshell 3x10..12 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m

  PHASE "Phase 2 — Weeks 3-6 (Early strengthening, core re-education; introduce low-impact steady cardio; avoid heavy abdominal loading)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Activation & posterior chain":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x20..30 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x10..12 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          hip_abduction 3x10..12 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10..12 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Low-impact cardio & upper":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          cycling 10m
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x10..12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Core re-education + walk":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 4x6..8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          dead_bug 4x8..10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          bird_dog 4x8..10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          walking 1x10..15 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 5m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Walk + squat pattern":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x25..30 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          squat 4x8..12 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x10..12 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x8..10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Elliptical or cycling steady":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          elliptical 15m
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Balance & conditioning walk":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 3x5..8 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          step_up 3x8..10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          lateral_lunge 3x6..8 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x10..12 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Endurance + strength":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x30..35 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x10..12 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10..12 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Low-impact cardio interval":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          cycling 12m
          elliptical 8m
          shoulder_press 2x8..10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Core-safe flow + walk":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 4x6..8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          bird_dog 4x8..12 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 3x10..12 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          walking 1x15..20 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 5m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Load tolerance + steady cardio":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x30..35 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          squat 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x12..15 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          plank 3x20..30 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Rowing or cycling steady":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 3m
        main straight_sets:
          rowing 12m
          cycling 8m
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Mobility & steady walk":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x30..35 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          lateral_lunge 3x8..10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          step_up 3x10..12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10..12 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m

  PHASE "Phase 3 — Weeks 7-12 (Intensified strength, progressive cardio & staged low-impact HIIT; core integrated post-clearance)" (6 weeks):

          cycling 10m
        cooldown:

      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper strength — with row interval":

        cooldown:

          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10..12 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
    WEEK 8:

          rowing 12m
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Core integration + upper":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          plank 3x40..60 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x30..45 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Unilateral strength & intervals":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          step_up 4x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          walking_lunge 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          cycling 10m
          pallof_press 3x12..15 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Strength focus — heavier sets + cardio":

          hip_thrust 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds

      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper heavy + core stability":

        cooldown:

      DAY Friday training 45m "Power & low-impact conditioning":

    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Heavy lower + longer steady cardio":

        cooldown:

      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper strength peak + intervals":

    WEEK 11:
